summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K announcing H1 2026 results (net profit €6.05B, +11.1% YoY; ROTE 22.2%) and a new €2B extraordinary share buyback program. The first €1B tranche starts August 5, 2026; terms for the remaining €1B await corporate approval. This issuer buyback returns capital to shareholders, separate from ordinary earnings reporting. No price per share, premium, or advisor stated. Structurally, capital generation supports the buyback; CET1 remains strong. Watch for execution of the second tranche and any regulatory approvals in Spain or EU banking rules.
